notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.9c
notes.content:
Added a tool to create profiles in the character selection menu when playing in local multiplayer mode.
 Fixed a short loss of control with pad at the end of a local multiplayer game in tournament mode when choosing to "resume" instead of restarting or changing the game mode.
 Fixed a loss of control when entering the main menu of the game until the mouse interact for the 1st time.
 Fixed visual artifacts from some screen ratio.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.1.9a
notes.content:
The in-game crown displaying the leading team by combining score was faulty in various team configurations.
 Fixed multiple visual glitches in the multiplayer level selection, added color highlight based on player selection in tournament modes.
 From now on, the game version will be displayed with a warning sign in the character selection when joining online multiplayer session if conflicting versions are used between clients and server.
 Tutorial has been soften and does not need to be completed to continue the adventure.
 The ambulance in local multiplayer display the player number on top of it, and in online multiplayer only display an arrow to indicate yourself for better readability.

notes.title: Update 0.1.9
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this post is very important for us, because it is the last levels of CIBOS. So there are 3 new levels playable in multi-online/Local.


 Burning bolt : you have 5 lives, to win, it's very simple, you will have to push your opponents in the flames.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32153182/987726cfdbbedaee49aee5a81c62d2971fddba59.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32153182/508bf0716146772d1eed86ee465b5e78f373f5ad.gif
 Opposing gravity: defy gravity in an arena of varying geographies and blast your opponents out of the gravity zone to electrocute them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32153182/2fa372fe222b56a1788eb761f1d56567c3cc2e03.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32153182/7f22b29786e4929f98039c1c3e7f9e796ca08989.gif
 Traffic Jam : You are on a highway of ships where you will have to steal bolts while being careful not to get knocked down, burned or dashed by your opponents. This last level is the most difficult one, so don't venture there if you don't have any skill!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32153182/c79b957fb7521af84d7462390c323d3f3df48a07.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32153182/7fadff76a5617b2876af270097354e06be6a81ad.gif
 Finally, discover the different game modes available for the online/local multiplayer game.


Don't hesitate to give us feedback!

notes.title: Mid Early Access Update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32153182/5112c19e7c7ea36b823df4782ac5476b4839d284.jpg

Greetings dear Cibos, It’s time for our mid Early Acces update about CIBOS on Steam.

It’s already been 4 month since the release of CIBOS, and we have just released our 5th updates bringing even more new levels and challenges. It’s why it’s maybe time for a little summary about our last features:

Climb up the pyramid scheme, dash your friends into fire or steal them bolts… Become the best employee over the galaxy whatever it takes!!!

The smelting plant fighting arena

https://i.imgur.com/NVF58AI.gif

The smelting plant is ready to welcome its new employee, but who will remain until the end? Up to 4 players, dash all your opponent into the fire to win this round.

The Thunder Wheel is spinning


https://i.imgur.com/uhMlZ5y.gif


Hit at the right time the green piston or feel the the vengeful striking hammer of the wheel if you touch the red one.

The Bolt reactor

https://i.imgur.com/M3tr1Kw.gif

The Bolt reactor has arrived: Up to 4 players Online and Local, compete and collect bolts before the hoovers steal them.

The Bolt Box

https://i.imgur.com/jzeAbCU.gif


Everyone has “The Boss” bonus, so you can’t be dashed or lose bolts. Your only goal is to collect as much bolts as you can in the limited time: Be quick or you’re fired!!

Boss of the pyramid scheme


https://i.imgur.com/f1R77tV.gif

Based on the “king of the hill” party game mode, we are presenting you the pyramid scheme!!!
You have one goal, the CIBOS on the top of the pyramid collect all the bolts and the others has to eject him to take his place.

However if you touch the laser, you have to climb the pyramid from the bottom

Early Access

notes.title: Cibos: Stupid, lovely but deadly (or not)
notes.content:
Howdy ho dear Cibos, 

Welcome to our 3rd weekly meeting about our upcoming crazy acrade-brawler Cibos.
 
Wishlist here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/728090/CIBOS/

https://i.imgur.com/6KclZkb.gif

Today we want to focus  a little bit more on the Cibos, this stupid but lovely employee that you will play in your quest for being the best employee over the galaxy (and losing your friends, but this is another story).


 
 
The creation of a Cibos:

 
Everything is better in motion, so here is a video showing you our concept arts, animation sheets… a little behind the scene of the creation of our game Cibos: 

https://youtu.be/zd_c0I78ldY
 


The sharpest tool in the shed:

https://i.imgur.com/2kcPx5d.gif

This little creatures spend their lives with the only purpose of becoming the best employee in the galaxy. 
So now, you are ready for your first day in the factory, have fun with your friends!!!
 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6uqrhicbCs0

 
Stay tuned, we will back next week!!!

notes.title: Cibos: The intergalactic gameplay
notes.content:
Greetings dear Cibos,

Welcome to our 2nd weekly meeting about our upcoming crazy acrade-brawler Cibos.

Now that you’ve discover our universe with our previous update from last week, we think it’s time to focus about the gampelay of Cibos, our upcoming crazy acrade-brawler. 
 

 
Gameplay: 

https://i.imgur.com/pz5lWLs.jpg
 
Solo mode: 

Reach the end of the levels or finish them in a limited time with the maximum bolts. 

https://i.imgur.com/xouKztA.gif

Multi-player mode:  

Up to 4 players in local or online, become the best employee of the galaxy by collecting bolts and fighting other Cibos trough differents levels. 

https://i.imgur.com/nsTlmvv.gif
 
Bonuses : 

- Various powers for Cibos.

You can collect power-up and unleash your “employee's skill” and turn the situation in your advantage.  
 
https://i.imgur.com/zqKUqBl.gif
 
- Moving arenas during the game phases.

https://i.imgur.com/n502Nki.gif
 
- Mini games 
Every 3 or 4 levels your will have access to a mini game, “It’s time for a coffee break!!”  
 
 https://i.imgur.com/5U5YiZh.gif
 
 
 


Stay tuned, we will back next week!!!

https://i.imgur.com/S3USbzv.gif

notes.title: Cibos: Something big is on its way!!!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/xEsPei5.jpg


Greetings dear Cibos, 


Welcome to our 1st weekly meeting about our upcoming crazy acrade-brawler Cibos. 

It's the first time that we meet you, so let's start with a video to present you Cibos our multiplayer game up to 4 players in local or online. 

Teaser
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_frmqrjt9JI


 

Soon you will be able to play up to 4 players in local or online with people from all around the world in order to become the best employee of the galaxy. 

https://i.imgur.com/tFER3Xm.gif


Screenshots: 

https://i.imgur.com/lznoTWL.png

https://i.imgur.com/7yP1gPf.png

https://i.imgur.com/3cg21VD.png

https://i.imgur.com/IPFD3dD.png

https://i.imgur.com/fdJw9f1.png




What’s a Cibos?

Cibos are little aliens who spend their lives at work. You are a Cibos ! 
Your job is to collect as much bolts as you can in a limited time. 

Run, jump, dodge and dash in every situation your friends in order to catch them all!!! 

The more bolts you have, the better your chances will be of becoming the best employee of the Galaxy!

https://i.imgur.com/24ffdYh.jpg

Sprites sheet animation:

https://i.imgur.com/hDUmeBK.gif

Stay tuned, we will back next week!!!

https://i.imgur.com/S3USbzv.gif
